'''Asadine''' occurs ten days before [[Sunday]], [[Amadaine]] [[Amadaine 3|3]]; a day of fasting, with no food taken between sunrise and sunset.

Celebrated in the [[Borderlands]] and in [[Cairhien]].

Borderlanders consider the day after Asadine to be a lucky day to wed.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 31}}
